title: Classic arcade games and the studio that made them

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?relLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?d) AS ?devSample) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?d) AS ?nDev) (SAMPLE(?p) AS ?pubSample) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?p) AS ?nPub) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q7889 ; wdt:P400 wd:Q192851 ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sl . FILTER(?sl >= 5) FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item wdt:P852 ?esrb . VALUES ?esrb { wd:Q14864331 wd:Q14864332 wd:Q110488287 wd:Q124356066 } } OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P178 ?d . } OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P123 ?p . } } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . BIND(IF(?nDev = 1, ?devSample, IF(?nPub = 1, ?pubSample, ?devSample)) AS ?rel) FILTER(?nDev = 1 || ?nPub = 1) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 654

rows.label: Pac-Man
rows.hook: has a yellow circle chomping dots through a maze while colorful ghosts chase it

rows.label: Tekken 3
rows.hook: is a 3D fighting game entry that puts Jin Kazama at the center of the tournament

rows.label: Street Fighter II (1991)
rows.hook: popularized combo-based one-on-one fighting and launched a wave of arcade challengers

rows.label: Pong
rows.hook: is a simple electronic table tennis game with two paddles and a bouncing ball

rows.label: Space Invaders
rows.hook: has rows of descending aliens that a lone cannon shoots from the bottom of the screen

rows.label: Donkey Kong
rows.hook: has a carpenter climbing ladders and leaping barrels to rescue a damsel from a giant ape

rows.label: Contra
rows.hook: is a run-and-gun shooter famous for a cheat code that grants thirty lives

rows.label: Mario Bros.
rows.hook: has two plumber brothers knocking pests off platforms as they emerge from pipes

rows.label: Street Fighter (1987)
rows.hook: started a legendary fighting franchise, starring a fireball-throwing hero named Ryu

rows.label: Ms. Pac-Man
rows.hook: added a bow-wearing heroine to a maze-chomping classic

rows.label: Golden Axe
rows.hook: sends a barbarian, an amazon and a dwarf through a fantasy land beating up enemies
